title: rubus corchorifolius var. crataegifolius
intro: Rubus corchorifolius var. crataegifolius, commonly known as the Himalayan raspberry or Himalayan strawberry, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits which may include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rubus corchorifolius var. crataegifolius include analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory actions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
